status: predeclared before candidate embeddings or grader outputs

content_sampling.method: KMeans on one image per family; proportional cluster allocation plus farthest-first selection within source/defect quotas
content_sampling.rehearsal_method: Capacity-capped sqrt(cluster-size) allocation plus farthest-first within source/operator quotas
content_sampling.benchmark_representative_method: Proportional cluster allocation with seeded random selection within fixed source quotas

duplicates.protected_holdouts: exclude family/source-group/hash and dHash distance<=2 to original dev/test
duplicates.review: inspect high embedding similarities jointly with pHash/dHash and original images; semantic similarity alone is not a duplicate
duplicates.historical_benchmark: historical family or dHash<=2 matches excluded

image_contract.resize: Prior-trial full-frame LANCZOS cap1536, reduce cap by0.9steps for common2.65MBPNGbudget; no upscale/crop/padding; sharedcap percontrolledfamily
image_contract.source_failures: record and replace deterministically before inference

stats.calibration: nonbenchmark family representatives only; controlled variants excluded
stats.gate: record for review only, no score replacement or skipped grader calls
stats.donor_mapping: seeded different-image/different-family donor with source/encoding and approximate dimensions matched; report sharpness direction balance
stats.donor_pool: Unique nonbenchmark nonvariant family representatives from same4000corpus
